reasoning: We need answer Chinese. Need identify task continuity: Current request refers to "刚才给家长的听课邀请" original task 1 invite SMS, revise more warm, still Wed 7pm, no location? It says still Wed 7pm. Need write short warm invite. Attach task marker exactly at end. Task is same as original invitation task, task 1, despite intervening task 2. Need not include locations. Keep under 200 Chinese chars. Normal direct. Maybe "亲爱的家长朋友们：周三晚上7点，我们准备了一场家长公开课，诚心邀请您来参加。期待和您一起交流、学习，等您哦！" But "给家长的听课邀请" maybe public class. Need warm. Ensure no location. Should mention Wednesday 7. Could say "亲爱的家长朋友：周三晚上7点，我们有一场家长公开课，诚邀您来参加。期待与您相见，一起聊聊孩子成长那些事～" This adds child growth not specified. Could be okay but avoid inventing too much. "亲爱的家长朋友们：周三晚上7点有一场家长公开课，诚邀您来参加。期待与您相聚，一起交流分享！" Warm enough. End marker. No code fence. Ensure exactly one marker at end, no extra after except whitespace.
